user_direction: Shift the two center supports outward to avoid stacked hardware.

symmetric_outward_shift_screen.definition: Move left center support/post toward negative X by delta and right toward positive X by delta, without moving panel/kicker screw axes.

limits: The geometric maximum only keeps the existing occupied panel bore inside the 38.1 mm support; it is not an edge-distance, withdrawal, or panel-strength acceptance.
No A66 factory bolt locations or actual stacked-hardware envelope are documented, so the offset required to clear them cannot yet be calculated.
An outward shift alters panel edge support and all center clip/post interfaces. The historical native responses do not transfer.

All six center-adjacent bottom/service rail inner ends must follow the shifted principals. A nominal CAD screen confirms their 12 retained panel screw cylinders still intersect timber at sampled 0/5/10/15 mm offsets, but does not establish structural rail-to-principal attachment.
Moving the 20 panel/kicker axes would change the frozen panel contract and requires an explicit revision; this screen holds them fixed.
disposition: A small outward shift is geometrically possible with the retained axes, but no offset is selected or released until the hardware interference and panel support are checked.
